description: Skills on how to create a better planet earth that doesn't face any threats
summary:
"When we look at our planet from space, we see a single, interconnected ecosystem. Yet on the ground, we have always treated global warming, land pollution, and marine degradation as completely separate crises. When toxic algal blooms suffocate our oceans, we look at coastal sources—completely missing the vital truth that the health of our seas begins miles inland in our farming soils.
Under erratic climate shifts, unpredictable storms force family farmers to over-apply synthetic fertilizers purely as a defensive financial measure to protect their seasonal yields. Heavy rains instantly wash these excess nutrients out of the fields and down regional river paths, discharging directly into coastal waters to create oxygen-depleted marine dead zones that collapse local fishing economies.
Agro-Ocean AI heals this cycle. We merge live land moisture profiles from NASA Landsat with marine color signatures from ESA's Sentinel-3 inside a Topographical Graph Neural Network. This transforms complex planetary matrices into simple cellular text notifications, telling farmers exactly when to skip application windows to save input costs on land while natively shielding Mother Earth's oceans at sea. Thank you."
details: Our project is an interactive, web-based platform that visualizes complex space data into clear, actionable insights for researchers and the general public. It works by ingesting raw datasets directly from NASA's Earth Observing System Data and Information System and the Socioeconomic Data and Applications Center . The application processes these data feeds, filters out background noise, and renders the information through a dynamic, user-friendly 3D mapping dashboard. The primary benefit of this system is that it bridges the gap between raw scientific telemetry and human understanding, allowing users to cross-reference planetary changes with local environmental impacts in seconds rather than hours. The intended long-term impact of the project is to accelerate open-science exploration, assist in community climate resilience, and inspire global audiences to engage with space agency data through accessible, open-source technology. To develop this application, we utilized a robust technical stack across data processing, design, and web hosting. The project achieves high creativity by transforming dense, text-heavy data points into an immersive, gamified visual map, making the data feel alive and explorable. During development, our team carefully considered key factors such as data accuracy, smooth rendering performance across both mobile and desktop screens, high web accessibility for users with disabilities, and strict adherence to open-source guidelines to ensure that anyone can build upon our work in the future.
